notes: This minor release adds the C# rethrown-exception-variable and todo-comment policies, corrects catch-of-all-exceptions to report exact catch-all handlers that do not use a bare throw;, including a throw of the caught variable, and adds C# password-in-configuration and empty-password-in-configuration policies aligned with CodeQL. The C# selectors exclude xmlns namespace declarations from XML attribute matches. The C# policy component advances to 0.3.0. The new policies use capabilities already required by this component. The release retains the exact dependency on bifrost.public.packs 0.6.1 for the reviewed JDK 21 result-use models and does not imply full policy qualification or complete analysis.
